<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_WantsBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetUrgency</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_UpdateRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateResourceList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectFriends</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FollowUpSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FollowUpJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Complete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_UpdateBranch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Bot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FarmResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_NaturalDisaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecoverSetback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_MilestoneBranch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_WantsBot" name="Player wants a custom farming bot"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseResources" name="Choose resources to farm"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetUrgency" name="Set resource urgency"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureDependencies" name="Configure resource and tool dependencies"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm selected resources">
      <bpmn:documentation>Up to 10 selected resources can be collected in parallel, subject to configured urgency and resource/tool dependencies.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:ioSpecification>
        <bpmn:dataInput id="DataInput_SelectedResources" name="Selected resources"/>
        <bpmn:inputSet>
          <bpmn:dataInputRefs>DataInput_SelectedResources</bpmn:dataInputRefs>
        </bpmn:inputSet>
        <bpmn:outputSet/>
      </bpmn:ioSpecification>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopDataInputRef>DataInput_SelectedResources</bpmn:loopDataInputRef>
        <bpmn:inputDataItem id="DataItem_Resource" name="Resource"/>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">naturalDisasterOccurs</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecoverSetback" name="Recover from disaster setback"/>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">milestoneReached</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MilestoneBranch"/>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_UpdateRequest" name="Farming list update requested" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingListUpdateRequested</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateResourceList" name="Update list of materials to farm"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_UpdateBranch"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFriends" name="Select friends"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FollowUpSplit" name="Choose follow-up actions"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FollowUpJoin" name="Join selected follow-up actions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Complete" name="Farming and selected follow-up actions complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Choose" sourceRef="StartEvent_WantsBot" targetRef="Task_ChooseResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choose_Urgency" sourceRef="Task_ChooseResources" targetRef="Task_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Urgency_Dependencies" sourceRef="Task_SetUrgency" targetRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dependencies_Farm" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_SelectFriends" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="Task_SelectFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_Recovery" sourceRef="Boundary_NaturalDisaster" targetRef="Task_RecoverSetback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Recovery_Farm" sourceRef="Task_RecoverSetback" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_Notify" sourceRef="Boundary_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_MilestoneBranch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_UpdateTask" sourceRef="Boundary_UpdateRequest" targetRef="Task_UpdateResourceList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateTask_UpdateEnd" sourceRef="Task_UpdateResourceList" targetRef="EndEvent_UpdateBranch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectFriends_Split" sourceRef="Task_SelectFriends" targetRef="Gateway_FollowUpSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_FollowUpSplit" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">braggingSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SendMaterials" sourceRef="Gateway_FollowUpSplit" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">materialsSendingSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Join" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_FollowUpJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendMaterials_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_FollowUpJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Complete" sourceRef="Gateway_FollowUpJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
